summary: Six silent-pass holes in papers/phase1-workshop/verify_paper.py, found by an adversarial audit under S34 and filed as this item. Headline: check D NOSECRET builds its secret list from a gitignored .env and so iterates zero times in every worktree ci_merge checks out -- the check standing between the ARC key and the Phase 4 release manifest is a no-op everywhere it matters.
key_shape_note: The ARC key is a canonical UUID: length 36, dashes at 8/13/18/23, parses as uuid.UUID. Established by reading .env through arc-recon/client.py and printing PROPERTIES ONLY (length, charset predicates, dash positions) -- the value was never printed, written, or committed. The shape is recorded here because check D's docstring already promises 'nothing shaped like the ARC key' and a shape detector cannot be written without it; a 36-char UUID shape discloses no part of a 128-bit value.
